name: Supplier bills: email to Google Sheet with AI checks (The Gantry blueprint)

parameters.content:
## Supplier bills: email to Google Sheet
Blueprint by The Gantry (gantry.work).

1. In Gmail, make a filter that labels supplier bills **supplier-bills** (or change the search on the trigger).
2. Fill in **Settings**: reviewer email, sheet name.
3. Connect Gmail on the trigger and on **Email the reviewer**.
4. Add your OpenAI key on **OpenAI Chat Model**. To use Claude instead, connect **Anthropic Chat Model** to the AI step in its place.
5. Create an empty Google Sheet with a tab called **Supplier bills** and pick it in **Log to Google Sheet**. The first run writes the headers.
6. Optional: enable the two Xero steps to create DRAFT bills (set xeroAccountCode first).

Nothing is ever approved or paid. Rows marked CHECK are emailed to a person with the PDF.

options.systemPromptTemplate:
You read supplier invoices received by a Singapore company and extract fields exactly as printed.
Rules:
- The supplier is the company that issued the document, not the company it is billed to.
- Dates in Singapore are day/month/year unless the month is written as a word. Return dates as YYYY-MM-DD.
- Amounts are plain numbers: no currency symbols, no thousands separators.
- subtotal is the amount before GST, gst is the GST or tax amount, total is the amount payable including GST.
- If the document shows no GST at all, return gst as 0.
- currency is the ISO code (SGD, USD, MYR...). S$ means SGD.
- document_type is one of: tax invoice, invoice, commercial invoice, credit note, statement, quotation, proforma invoice, receipt, delivery order, other.
- Never calculate or guess a value that is not printed. If a field is not on the document, leave it out.

parameters.content: **Model swap:** the AI step uses one model at a time. OpenAI is connected. To use Claude, delete the connection from OpenAI and drag one from **Anthropic Chat Model** instead. Any chat model n8n supports works (Gemini, Mistral, Azure OpenAI, a local model).
